name: Switzerland
tagline: Europe's highest railway station, reached in time for lunch
hero_description: Switzerland is alpine drama made effortless: trains run to a station carved into the mountain at 3,454 m (Jungfraujoch, above the Alps' longest glacier), panoramic carriages cross 291 bridges on the Glacier Express, and towns like Lucerne and Interlaken sit postcard-ready between lakes and peaks. You never need hiking boots — though you may want them.
best_time_to_visit: Late June to early September for open trails, running lifts and wildflower meadows; mid-September–October is quieter and crisp — and Jungfraujoch stays snowy whatever the month.

top_attractions.name: Jungfraujoch — Top of Europe
top_attractions.description: Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 m, reached from Interlaken via Kleine Scheidegg — walk the Ice Palace tunnels and step onto the Sphinx terrace above the Aletsch Glacier, the longest in the Alps.

top_attractions.name: Glacier Express
top_attractions.description: The 'world's slowest express' — around eight hours from Zermatt to St. Moritz over 291 bridges, through 91 tunnels, and across the 2,033 m Oberalp Pass, all behind panoramic glass.

top_attractions.name: Interlaken
top_attractions.description: A resort town wedged between the blue-green of Lake Thun and Lake Brienz — the Harder Kulm funicular puts both lakes and the Eiger-Mönch-Jungfrau wall in one view.

top_attractions.name: Lucerne & the Chapel Bridge
top_attractions.description: A preserved medieval old town on its lake, crossed by the 14th-century Kapellbrücke — one of Europe's oldest covered wooden bridges — with Mt. Pilatus rising behind.

top_attractions.name: Chillon Castle, Montreux
top_attractions.description: A moated 12th-century island castle on Lake Geneva's shore near Montreux — among the most-visited historic buildings in Switzerland.

top_attractions.name: GoldenPass route
top_attractions.description: The panoramic rail line linking Interlaken to Montreux — from Bernese Oberland chalets down to Lake Geneva vineyards in an afternoon.

activities: Rail excursion to Jungfraujoch with the Ice Palace and Sphinx terrace
A panoramic segment of the Glacier Express
Boat cruise on Lake Brienz or Lake Thun
Sunset funicular to Harder Kulm above Interlaken
Mt. Pilatus 'golden round trip' by boat, cogwheel and cable car
Chillon Castle visit along the Montreux lakeside walk
